annotations.title: Match a funder request to a program

description: Given a foundation officer / DAF advisor / corporate CSR query (e.g. "fund veteran emergency aid", "homelessness prevention veterans", "trans veteran healthcare grant", "matching gift platform Microsoft veterans", "veteran homeownership"), classifies the institutional-funding intent to one of 5 program landing pages and returns the canonical /grants/{slug} URL plus funding-ask range, NTEE code, cause area, and program model summary. Use when an AI agent is helping a foundation officer or institutional funder evaluate Wounded Warriors. Returns matched_program (emergency-aid / hrt-sponsorships / care-packages / housing / partnerships / general), confidence, action URL, funding-ask range, NTEE code, and 1-line program rationale. More specific than the generic /grants/ page.

funder_type.description: Optional — funder type for tailored response

query.description: Free-text institutional-funder intent (e.g. "veteran homelessness grant", "trans veteran HRT funding", "corporate matching gifts veterans")
